visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Buttons on one line instead of stacked
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The three buttons should be stacked in a column on the phone, but they sit side by side in one row. The direction is not set.

solution.explanation: A flex container lays its children out in a row unless flex-direction says otherwise. Add flex-direction: column to stack them.

checks.label: The buttons are stacked
checks.expr: (() => { var b = document.querySelectorAll('.bar button'); return b[0].offsetTop < b[1].offsetTop && b[1].offsetTop < b[2].offsetTop; })()
